column2: Theme. Whether the launcher follows the system's light or dark setting, or stays light or dark. People say: too bright; my eyes hurt at night; eyes hurt at night; dark mode; light mode; switch to the dark theme; the screen is blinding

Terminal contrast. How hard the terminal's colours are, from soft pastels to the deepest background and brightest text. People say: hard to read; text is hard to read on my wallpaper; colours are too harsh; colours look washed out; my eyes hurt at night
Text size. How large text is across the launcher's own screens, in percent. People say: too small; too big; hard to read; can't read the text; make the text bigger; make the text smaller

Animation speed. How fast the launcher's own animations run, or whether they play at all. People say: animations are too slow; animations are too fast; my phone feels slow; turn the animations off; the motion makes me dizzy

Page transition. How a page turns when you swipe between Home pages, the Terminal and windows. People say: swiping between pages looks odd; change the page animation; pages slide too much; swiping between pages is laggy
Idle animations. Lets the retro screen effect play small glitches while the terminal sits idle. People say: the screen keeps moving; my battery drains too fast; stop the glitching
Idle glitch rate. How often the idle animations glitch the terminal. People say: the glitches happen too often; glitch less; glitch more
Cursor trail. Draws a trail behind the terminal's cursor as it moves. People say: the cursor leaves a streak; my phone feels slow; turn off the cursor effect
Wallpaper parallax. Moves the wallpaper a little as pages and windows slide. People say: swiping between pages is laggy; the wallpaper moves when I swipe; my phone feels slow
Live windows. Keeps windows updating while you swipe between them. People say: swiping between pages is laggy; windows freeze when I swipe; my phone feels slow
Reduce idle activity. Lets the launcher do less in the background while you are not using it. People say: my battery drains too fast; my phone feels slow; save battery
Glass refraction. Makes glass surfaces bend and shine the way real glass does. People say: swiping between pages is laggy; my phone feels slow; the glass looks too fancy
Live blur. Blurs whatever moves behind glass surfaces, not just the wallpaper. People say: my battery drains too fast; swiping between pages is laggy; the blur looks stale
Terminal effect. Gives the terminal an old monitor look, or none. People say: I don't like the retro screen effect; the screen looks like an old TV; remove the scanlines; I want a retro look
Screen events. Lets the terminal's bell and other events flicker the screen effect. People say: the screen flickers when something beeps; stop the flashing
Effect blending. Blends the retro effect into the terminal's colours. People say: my battery drains too fast; my phone feels slow
Battery in the status bar. Shows the battery level in the status bar. People say: show the battery; I can't see my battery level; show the battery percentage
Media in the status bar. Shows what is playing in the status bar. People say: show what's playing; I can't see the song; hide the music from the status bar
Weather in the status bar. Shows the weather in the status bar. People say: I want to see the weather up top; show the weather; hide the weather
AM and PM on the clock. Shows AM or PM beside the status bar clock. People say: the clock should show am/pm; I can't tell morning from evening; remove am/pm from the clock

Dock style. Whether the dock and bars sit on the screen's edge or float as cards. People say: the dock should float; the dock touches the edge of the screen; I want rounded cards; make the dock square
Notification dots. Marks app icons that have notifications. People say: I can't tell which apps have messages; show a dot on apps with notifications
Notification badge. Whether an app icon shows a dot or the number of notifications. People say: I want to see how many notifications; the dot is not enough
Quick reply swipe. Swipe up on an app icon that has a notification to reply from the dock. People say: I swipe up by accident; icons open a reply when I swipe
Keyboard when the drawer opens. Opens the keyboard as soon as the app drawer opens. People say: the keyboard pops up by itself when I open the drawer; I want to search as soon as the drawer opens
Most-used apps page. Adds a drawer page ranked by how often you open each app. People say: I want my most used apps first; add a page of my favourite apps
Terminal core. Which engine new terminals run on. People say: the terminal is slow; use ghostty; switch the terminal engine; the terminal draws some glyphs wrong
Scrollback. How many lines a terminal keeps for scrolling back. People say: I can't scroll back far enough; keep more history in the terminal; the terminal forgets old output
Bell. What a terminal does when a program rings its bell. People say: the phone vibrates when I press tab; stop the terminal beeping; turn off the bell
Display server. Whether Linux apps open on X11 or on Wayland, each app in its own window. People say: open linux apps in their own windows; use wayland; go back to x11

Camera cutout. Keeps clear of the camera where the phone reports it, or where you place it. People say: the camera covers the bar; something is hidden under the camera; my phone reports the camera in the wrong place
Room around the camera. How much space is kept clear around the camera cutout, in dp. People say: things sit too close to the camera; leave more room around the camera
Key sound. Plays a click as you type on the launcher keyboard. People say: the keyboard is silent; turn off the typing sound; keys should click
Key preview. Shows the letter above your finger as you press a key. People say: I can't see which key I pressed; hide the key popups
Vibrate on keypress. Gives a short vibration for each key you press. People say: the keyboard vibrates too much; stop the keyboard buzzing; I want to feel the keys
Terl desktop. Opens on Home and Workspaces of windows, in place of the dock and status bar. People say: turn on the tiling desktop; try Terl
Extra keys row. Shows a row of extra keys above the keyboard, for typing with your phone's own keyboard. People say: show the extra keys; bring back the key row above the keyboard
Drawer item. Shows the drawer's button in Home's bottom row. People say: show the drawer button; hide the drawer button
Rail side. Which side of the screen the control bar stands down in landscape. People say: move the bar to the left in landscape; put the rail on the other side
Reading. Shows one reading (CPU, GPU, memory, battery, weather or media) at the end of the bar's top row. People say: show the battery on the bar; hide the reading on the bar
Reading shown. Which reading stands at the end of the bar's top row. People say: show the weather on the bar; show the memory on the bar
Margin. The air around the control bar, in dp. 0 stands it flush with the screen's edges. People say: make the bar flush; the bar floats too far from the edge
Gap. The air between windows, in dp. People say: windows are too close together
Rim. A line round the window that has the keys. People say: I can't tell which window is focused
Rim colour. The colour of the focused window's rim. Accent follows the Tint.
Unfocused dim. How much the windows without the keys are darkened, in percent. People say: dim the windows I'm not typing in
Opacity. How see-through Linux windows are, in percent. An app's own page can set its own. People say: make Linux windows see-through

Leader. What starts every shortcut: the Terl key (Ctrl+Alt on a hardware keyboard), Ctrl+Alt, or keys you choose. People say: my shortcuts clash with an app; Ctrl+Alt shortcuts get in the way; change the shortcut key; use a different key for shortcuts

Keyboard layout. The letters the launcher keyboard types: QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, Colemak, or your own layout. People say: I use a different keyboard layout; switch to dvorak; use azerty; the keys are in the wrong place
Global blur. How frosted the glass is, from clear to heavily frosted.
Global grain. How much film grain sits on the glass, in percent.
Global opacity. How solid the glass is, in percent.
Global tint. How strongly the theme colour tints the glass, in percent.
Global tint colour. Which theme colour tints the glass.
Global depth. How strongly the glass bends the wallpaper at its edge, in dp.
Global edge. No longer used; Shine replaced it.
Global corners. How round the corners are, in dp; the lowest value follows each surface's style.
Global rim. No longer used; Shine replaced it.
Global shine. How much light catches the glass's rim and lens.
Global vibrancy. How much the glass lifts the colours behind it.
Global edge gap. The gap between the glass and the screen edge, in dp.
Status bar opacity. The status bar's own opacity; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Status bar blur. The status bar's own blur; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Dock opacity. The dock's own opacity; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Dock blur. The dock's own blur; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Keyboard opacity. The keyboard's own opacity; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Keyboard blur. The keyboard's own blur; until you set one it follows the Global look.
Terminal background opacity. How solid the terminal panes' background is, in percent.
Terminal background blur. How blurred the wallpaper behind the terminal panes is, in dp.
Terminal background wallpaper dim. How much the wallpaper behind the terminal is darkened, in percent.
Terminal font size. How large the terminal's text is, in pixels.
Compact font size. How large text is in Compact windows; until you set one it follows the terminal's.
Scratchpad font size. How large text is in the scratchpad; until you set one it follows the terminal's.

Low memory preset. Switches off the costliest effects and lightens the look so the launcher runs on less. People say: my phone feels slow; my battery drains too fast; the launcher uses too much memory; swiping between pages is laggy; make it run on my old phone
Use Terl as. Whether Terl is your home screen with Home pages, or a terminal that opens on its windows. People say: I don't want a home screen; only use it as a terminal; bring back my home screen
